The nRF24L01 is a low-power 2.4 GHz wireless transceiver module for short-range data communication.
It can both transmit and receive data, enabling two-way wireless communication.
It communicates with microcontrollers such as Arduino, ESP32, and STM32 through SPI.
It supports data rates up to 2 Mbps and payloads of up to 32 bytes per packet.
It features automatic acknowledgement, retransmission, and low-power operation, making it suitable for wireless control and sensor applications.
